positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: what distinguishes intelligence that is owned and retained from intelligence that is merely rented or used?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same categorical, principle-level distinction — src-2 sets owned against rented intelligence, src-3 splits substrate-as-commodity from perspective-as-asset-you-keep — matched antithetical structure, calm-positive settled conviction, and an autonomy/self-enhancement value appeal recur across both, with no existing position in this fresh space to attach to.
